anti_overfit_boundary: No model coefficient, seed, race, world, threshold or stratum changes after scoring.
No selector/adaptive-mixture tuning in this experiment.
No real/historical data, odds, RESULT/PAYOUT, ROI, bankroll or economics inputs.
Classification is diagnostic only and cannot promote a real Keirin model.

CLEAN_SPECIALIZATION: C0 W0 mean KL <= 0.95 * N2 W0 mean KL on both seeds.
N2 W2 mean KL <= 0.90 * C0 W2 mean KL on both seeds.
N2_DOMINATES_W0_W2: N2 W0 mean KL <= C0 W0 mean KL on both seeds.
N2 W2 mean KL <= 0.90 * C0 W2 mean KL on both seeds.

purpose: Determine whether C0 and frozen N2 are genuinely specialized for W0/W2 or whether N2 dominates both, explaining why adaptive mixture v7 preferred N2_ONLY.
